items.text: An existing full-page DAO creation wizard needs a prefilled member-management step. Produce a compile-oriented implementation handoff, not a standalone prototype. Identify the supported design-system composition and exact contracts needed to: initialize existing member addresses, let users add/edit/remove rows, distinguish editable input from accepted/resolved addresses, report invalid and duplicate entries through the owning form, and preserve the wizard's existing form ownership and navigation. Include required provider assumptions, relevant address-resolution/checksum/network semantics, and revision-matched source or example references available in this project. Call out any tempting but incorrect nesting or state-ownership choices. Do not invent APIs; explicitly mark anything the supplied project cannot establish.

Reading ×17, Listing files ×4, Searching ×10, Writing, Editing, Finishing up

Handoff written to Members Step Handoff.html.

The load-bearing findings, all read out of the compiled bundle rather than prose:

AddressesInput.Container owns the useFieldArray and drops any child whose index exceeds the array length, so the step must render one Item per entry from a useWatch on the same name — a fixed child count silently breaks Add/Clear.
Row values are { address, name }, seeded from the wizard's defaultValues; each item seeds its visible text once at mount, so post-mount setValue won't update what's displayed.
Checksum enforcement lives in AddressInput (enforceChecksum default true); the App's invalid/duplicate validator uses addressUtils.isAddress with { strict: false } and flags only the later duplicate. ENS is always mainnet; chainId is explorer-only.
Nesting FormWrapper inside the wizard is the main trap — it forks the form context and drops members from submit.

Section 9 lists what this bundle cannot establish (create-DAO step list and field shape, locale strings, any existing fieldPrefix, min-count/self-inclusion policy, analytics values).

Created Members Step Handoff.html

Reading, Check design system

I can't fix these — both issues live in _ds_bundle.css, which is synced, read-only source in this project (styles.css only @imports it, and my one writable surface is templates/).

They're also both benign artifacts of compiled Tailwind output, not authoring mistakes:

The 32 "component-style selector" properties are Tailwind's internal --tw-* and .prose variables emitted inside utility rules. They aren't theme tokens and shouldn't be hoisted to :root — doing so would change cascade behavior.
The 15 unclassified tokens are animation/easing/transform variables (--ease-out, --animate-spin, --tw-translate-x…). They genuinely aren't color/spacing/radius/shadow/font; they'd want /* @kind other */.

To clear them, the annotations need to be added in the source repo and re-synced with /design-sync — worth flagging to that agent on the next run, since a regenerated bundle would drop any edit made here anyway.
